name: altimator
description: Altimator Service Bay v2: interactive 2000 Nissan Altima service bay web app. React + TanStack Router + three.js. Load real GLB parts per-part, interactive removable/explosable components. FUTURE: Phase 7: Multi-car support (add more vehicles). Phase 8: Collaborative service mode (multi-user). Phase 9: AR/VR support for service visualization.

name.name: Phase 1: App scaffold and routing (React + TanStack Router)
Phase 2: GLB part loading and 3D scene setup
Phase 4: Per-part interactive removal and explosion
Phase 5: UI overlay and service manual integration
Phase 6: Performance optimization and mobile support
Phase 9: AR/VR support for service visualization

retroactive_audit.notes: Phases 1-3 completed (app scaffold, GLB loading, asset path fix). Phase 4 (interactive removal/explosion) in progress. Documentation at /opt/altimator/docs/ (3 files, 64KB total).
